messages:
sara: FYI noticed a spike in TLS handshake failures in eu-west after tonight's RBAC push. ~1% of proxied requests failing with KMS unwrap errors and cert verify fails.
sara: Example log: ```ERROR edge-proxy: tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate; unwrap: AccessDenied: User cannot perform kms:Decrypt on key projects/prod/keys/edge-keystore```
raj: Which RBAC PR was that?
sara: PR 4129 1840: scoped keystore bindings to service account principals and removed a legacy wildcard.
lia: Could be principal name mismatch (service account naming vs workload id). Any KMS audit entries?
raj: Pulling audit logs now.
auditbot: KMS Audit: 42 UnwrapDenied events in eu-west in last 12m for key alias/edge-keystore. Principal: system:serviceaccount:edge:edge-processor-sa -> denied.
jordan: If unwrap denied the proxy falls back and presents either a stale cert or self-signed. Downstream rejects on verify 1 matches client errors.
taylor-sec: Do we have the IAM binding prior to the PR?
sara: Yes 1 backup snapshot from 2026-03-20 contains binding role/keystore-unwrap -> edge-processor-sa. Diff shows it was removed by PR 4129.
raj: Quick mitigation: re-add kms:Decrypt allow for edge-processor-sa in eu-west and restart canary proxies. If unwrap succeeds, RBAC change is the cause.
lia: Also we should add an audit-only preflight in RBAC CI to attempt an unwrap against staging key for each affected service account.
ops-bot: Deploybot: Rollback available: revert PR 4129 (pipeline 8832). Run `./infra rollback 4129 --env eu-west-canary` to revert on canary.
sara: Rolling back canary now. Monitoring. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
raj: After rollback canary proxies show handshake success, KMS unwraps succeed, UnwrapDenied events drop to 0.
auditbot: Audit: UnwrapDenied events cleared in canary window.
sara: Agreed remediation plan: 1) hold cluster-wide RBAC rollout; 2) emergency revert in prod if errors escalate; 3) follow-up RFC proposing IAM-binding diff checks in RBAC PRs + automated KMS unwrap smoke tests in CI.
taylor-sec: Long term: change policy generator to emit explicit service account principals (avoid broad removals), and add pre-merge simulation of service-account-to-key access across regions.
lia: Filing incident ticket INC-2026-1443 with timeline, remediation, and affected services.
jordan: Post-incident action: add RBAC checklist item "run KMS unwrap smoke for all regions" and include audit log asserts in deploy pipeline.
sara: Thanks all. Flagging edge-processor owner teams to validate. :thumbsup:
